messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 34(2)

Article 34 Notification procedure. 2. The notifying authority shall send a notification to the Commission and the other Member States, using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission.

response.text: notifying authority | mustSendNotification | notification to the Commission and the other Member States | using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission | The notifying authority shall send a notification to the Commission and the other Member States, using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission.
